column13: Start the mission by tapping “Start Tracking.” Walk naturally around the mall and let the distance accumulate automatically. Once the required distance is reached, the system will display the completion screen. Tap “Complete Mission” to save your progress. There is no need to walk faster—simply focus on the act of walking itself.
column14: 在日常移動之中，我們往往只顧目的地，而忽略了身體正在經歷的過程。這段短短的步行，並不是為了走得更快，而是讓您重新感受腳步與地面的接觸、呼吸的節奏，以及身體正在前行的感覺。停一停，行一步，其實已經是一種照顧自己的方式。
column15: In daily movement, we often focus only on the destination and overlook what our body is experiencing along the way. This short walk is not about going faster, but about reconnecting with the contact between your feet and the ground, your breathing rhythm, and the sensation of your body moving forward. Pause for a moment—each step can be a way of caring for yourself.
column16:
您已完成這段步行。
距離不長，但請記住身體前行的感覺。
column17: You have completed this walk. The distance was not long, but remember the feeling of your body moving forward.

column12: 當您走到指定 Check Point，系統會透過 GPS 確認您已到達此地點。唔需要打卡、唔需要影相，只要您喺呢一刻，真正站喺呢個位置，就可以完成任務。請停一停，感受自己身處城市之中。
column13: When you reach the designated checkpoint, the system will confirm your arrival via GPS. No check-in and no photos are required. Simply being present at this location is enough to complete the mission. Pause for a moment and notice yourself standing within the city.
column14: 生活每日都在催促我們趕路，我們卻很少問自己身在何處。當定位顯示已到達，並不只是座標被確認，而是您與這個空間短暫重疊。請留意腳下的觸感、周圍的聲音與空氣流動，讓身體知道：我在這裡。
column15: Life constantly urges us to move faster, yet we rarely ask ourselves where we truly are. When your location is confirmed, it is not just a coordinate—it is a brief overlap between you and this space. Notice the texture beneath your feet, the surrounding sounds, and the movement of air, reminding yourself: I am here.
column16:

column17: Congratulations on reaching this destination. Not because of GPS, but because you came, stood here, and truly felt this place.

column17: This photo records more than food—it captures the moment of sharing a meal with dayday. Sometimes, what makes a meal enjoyable is simply having company.

You can also write about your goals, present feelings, or words you wish to say to your future self. Once completed, the letter will be saved and sent.
